phases.summary: The root architecture and image manifests define ISA v2, executable/function ABI v3, tBoot v3, and tDisk v2 as the only supported platform contract.
The compiler, assembler, VM, kernel, and native OS expose only ISA v2 with executable and function ABI v3; non-current executable inputs are rejected and are not migrated.
Current image serialization and loading use tBoot v3 and tDisk v2 only; non-current or corrupt images are rejected and must be rebuilt from source.
The current checkout has a small CMake/CTest graph and a single supported Python entry point for doctor, contract checks, validation, and diagnostics.
Future device, driver, UI, profile, and acceleration work remains documented as future scope and is not claimed as current implementation.
open_items: Define future hardware and product contracts before adding them to the current-only build graph.
